subject: Re: Pilot extension request — trial length, seats, and pricing options
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@brightwell.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: Carlos Mendes <carlos.m@brightwell.ai>
Date: 2026-10-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot extension and pricing question

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency numbers and the quick onboarding. We have a couple of asks before we move to procurement:

- We need an additional 2 weeks on the pilot (current pilot ends 11/10) to complete our clinical integration testing.
- Can you provide an updated rate for 10 concurrent seats during the extended window? We expect a burst to ~15k tokens/day while we run real data.
- Is there flexibility on a short-term discount or credits for evaluation customers? Our legal prefers credits vs. straight percentage discounts, but we can be flexible.

Can you confirm what you can do by EOD Monday? We need a short note for our procurement team.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Head of Integrations, Brightwell Health
S: +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: Brightwell_POC_SOW_v1.pdf (1 page)
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@brightwell.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-27T13:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot extension and pricing question

Thanks Samantha — appreciate the clear asks. Quick note: I'm looping in Ben (SE) to size the expected cost for the extra two weeks and the burst. We can do either a straight discount or a one-time credit; I want to make sure the economics are fair for both sides.

Ben — can you run three scenarios (no change / 20% discount / $X credit + 4 hours of engineer time) and flag any capacity concerns for 10 concurrent seats + 15k token/day burst? Need to reply to Brightwell by Monday EOD.

I can also offer a conditional extension: we give the two-week extension if they sign a short addendum that commits to a procurement timeframe (PO/MSA within 30 days). Will confirm after Ben's numbers.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (650) 555-0123
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-29T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot extension and pricing question — sizing + options

Vivek — did the sizing. Short summary: current pilot baseline (5 seats) is ~2.2k tokens/day average; bump to 10 seats with 15k token/day burst increases GPU-hours by ~3.2x during peak days. Key points:

- Option A (status quo): No change — we absorb extra two weeks as goodwill. Cost to Redwood: estimated incremental run cost ~$2,400 (GPU + infra) for the window.
- Option B (20% discount on token usage for the extension): Customer sees immediate discounted invoice; Redwood foregoes ~20% of incremental usage revenue (~$3,600).
- Option C (one-time credit of $15,000 applied to future invoice + 4 hours integration support): Puts more value in their pocket and helps procurement (credits are easier to handle); Redwood cost today is the same as A for runtime, but credit impacts future revenue.

Recommendation: Option C. Credits coupled with a small contractual commitment (PO within 30 days) gives us the best chance to convert without setting a discount precedent. If Marissa approves the credit, we can send a short addendum and DocuSign.

Attached: usage_estimate.xlsx (breakdown of estimated daily tokens and GPU-hours).
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-30T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Approval request — Brightwell pilot credit vs discount

Marissa — quick ask: Brightwell is asking for a 2-week extension and pricing flexibility. Ben recommends a $15k one-time credit plus 4 hours of integration help (Option C) in exchange for a signed PO/MSA within 30 days. The credit would be applied to their first paid invoice.

Rationale: avoids headline discounts, gives procurement a tangible lever, and keeps unit economics intact.

Can you confirm OK to proceed with the credit + extension and the 30-day PO condition? If yes, I'll prepare the addendum and DocuSign envelope.

Thanks for the quick turnaround — they want a note for procurement Monday.

— Vivek
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-31T11:16:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Approval request — Brightwell pilot credit vs discount

Vivek — approved. Offer the $15,000 one-time credit, include 4 hours SE time, and a 2-week extension. Conditions:

- Addendum must state PO or signed MSA within 30 calendar days of the addendum signature.
- Credit expires 90 days after the first paid invoice (limits long-tail recognition).
- No other customers should see identical language (we'll mark it as customer-specific concession).

Approve send to customer. I'll backstop if procurement pushes for a percentage discount instead.

Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@brightwell.ai>
Cc: Carlos Mendes <carlos.m@brightwell.ai>, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-02T14:38:00-08:00
Subject: Brightwell pilot — final offer and addendum

Hi Samantha — thanks for the patience. Good news: we can accommodate the two-week extension and the burst. Final offer below (approved by our commercial ops):

- 2-week extension to the existing pilot window (new end date: 2026-11-24).
- One-time credit of $15,000 applied to Brightwell's first paid invoice.
- 4 hours of Redwood SE time to assist with integration and runbook validation (scheduling via our CS team).
- Condition: Addendum requires signed PO or MSA within 30 calendar days of addendum signature. Credit expires 90 days after first paid invoice.

I've attached a short addendum (revised_terms_credit_offer.docx) and opened a DocuSign envelope for the addendum so procurement can sign quickly: https://www.docusign.com/signer?session=abc123-ttl

If that works, sign, and we'll schedule the SE hours and extend the pilot immediately. Thanks — we look forward to continuing the partnership.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (650) 555-0123

Attachments: revised_terms_credit_offer.docx (1 page)
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@brightwell.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: Carlos Mendes <carlos.m@brightwell.ai>
Date: 2026-11-05T17:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Brightwell pilot — final offer and addendum

Vivek — that package works for us. We'll sign the addendum today and route to procurement for PO. Please include an invoice stub that shows the $15k credit applied so procurement can reconcile. Also confirm the contact for scheduling the 4 SE hours — Carlos will coordinate availability.

Once signed, we'll target the extended window and start the integration hours next week. Thanks for the flexibility.

Best,
Samantha
Head of Integrations, Brightwell Health
Attachment: Signed_Addendum_stub.pdf (application/pdf)
